g.title: Text order overview; large diagrams show evenly spaced segment IDs.
TS1: Adam and Johan grew up in the same house.
TS2: Years earlier, Karl had carried Adam through the rain.
TS3: Margaret remembered her mother in Jakarta.
TS4: Meanwhile, Karl traveled alone across the island.
TS5: Adam searched for Margaret after the storm. Margaret found Adam at the doorway.
